Team — internal notes and suggested positions for a response to MedicoRE redlines. I exported my annotations as a PDF (redline_comments_kimberly_20280720.pdf) and attached a short playbook below.

Summary of material asks from customer redline:
- Subprocessor notice window -> Customer asked for 30 days
- EU->US transfer -> Customer requested SCCTS + additional one-way transfer language
- Retention/Deletion -> Customer tightened deletion obligations and asked for data return confirmation on contract termination
- Indemnity/Limitations -> minor tweaks; counsel to confirm viability

Recommended Redwood positions (high-level):
1) Subprocessors: Accept 30-day notice for MedicoRE with the condition that emergency security fixes may be deployed on a 48-72 hour exception window with notice after the fact.
2) Transfers: We will propose a transfer clause that references the latest SCCs and our Addendum for EU-US transfers. Counsel prefers not to include bespoke one-way language; propose offering the SCCs + standard transfer addendum and a customer-specific attestation instead.
3) Evidence: Jonas, please confirm what we can package (redacted SOC 2, penetration test summary, ISO attestations if any, data flow diagrams).

Action items:
- Marissa: produce annotated redline and proposed counter (by Mon 7/23).
- Jonas: evidence bundle + short cover memo (by Mon 7/23).
- Kimberly: offer ESR (executive sign-off) path if customer needs faster SLA.

Attachments: redline_comments_kimberly_20280720.pdf (internal), Privacy_Annex_Evidence_List.pdf (draft)

-Marissa
